tooltip.pure:
Basic Resistance EH
h0 = (r0,sl · Lsl + r0,yd · Lyd) / 1000
r0 = 2.439 + (0.00008·Q − 0.01743)·t − 0.015·Q + 0.00017·t² + 0.1·v + n·1.65·σ + (1−k)·0.39
σ = 0.602 − (0.0012 + 0.00002·Q)·t − 0.003·Q + 0.00002·t²
Q = {Q} t; t = {temp} °C; n = {n} (wagon type); vsl = {vSlope} m/s (k=0); vyd = {vYard} m/s (k=1); r0,sl = {r0Slope} N/kN; r0,yd = {r0Yard} N/kN; Lsl = {lSlope} m; Lyd = {lYard} m
tooltip.air:
Wind Resistance EH
hw = (rw,sl · Lsl + rw,yd · Lyd) / 1000
rw = (ρ · f · cx1/cx0) / (2 · Q · cos²α) · (v + ξ · vw · cosβ)²
α = arctan((vw · sinβ) / (v + ξ · vw · cosβ))
Q = {Q} t; ρ = {rho} kg·s²/m⁴; f = {f} m²; vw = {vWind} m/s; ξ = {xi}; β = 0°; α = 0°; cx1/cx0 = 1; vsl = {vSlope} m/s; vyd = {vYard} m/s; rw,sl = {rwSlope} N/kN; rw,yd = {rwYard} N/kN; Lsl = {lSlope} m; Lyd = {lYard} m
tooltip.switch:
Switch Resistance EH
hs = Es / 1000
Es = 24·Nrev + 12·(Nfwd + Ndia) + 48·Nslip
Nrev = {nReverse}; Nfwd = {nForward}; Ndia = {nDiamond}; Nslip = {nSlip}; Es = {Es} N·m/kN
tooltip.curve:
Curve Resistance EH
hc = Ec / 1000
Ec = 8 · θtotal = 8 · (θcurve + θswitch)
θcurve = {pureCurve} ° (curve corner); θswitch = {switchCurve} ° (switch corner); θtotal = {totalCurve} °; Ec = {Ec} N·m/kN
